calls.action: Read .pilot/pilot-process.md, pilot-link-existing-analysis.md, pilot-link-ticket-tree.md and pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md (and roster) before running.
Determine input: raw idea 'Let travelers save a place as a favorite.' with --human (product idea, not tech/bug, so proceed).
Fetch open level:epic issues (title+body) as candidate Epics; none exist.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-analyze-existing.md, the analysis link in full, the raw idea and the (empty) Epic list; hold the analysis and show the human its 'Touched by this input' and 'Not covered' parts.

With --human, ask the human once for their proposal (one story or several, Epic, acceptance criteria, decisions already held); also run PM framing rounds (pilot-task-frame-idea.md) challenging what the human stated, feeding replies back until the brief is ready and the human confirms it.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-write-story.md, the analysis, the validated brief, the human's proposal and Epic list to write up and challenge the draft; then call pilot-architect with pilot-task-anticipate-architecture.md, the analysis, the draft, plus knowledge and architecture links (architecture module on) to validate; on objection run the dialogue with PM and human, and put any human-needing question to the human before creating anything.

Create the draft story ticket(s) (type:feature, level:story, status:draft, priority, assigned to session; Epic only if the dialogue decides several stories), then run pilot.py event <n> --action created --phase discovery.

Show the human the drafted story with its real issue number and anticipated architecture; put the PM's remaining open questions to the human; ask once about a mockup (UI involved); check ticket comments for attachments; write each round's changes into the draft; repeat until approved (or wont-do and close if out of scope).
Final consolidation: have the dialogue re-read each draft ticket body as a whole and fix incoherences across rounds.
Finalize: flip each story from status:draft to status:backlog, unassigned (no --from-proto steps apply).
Dashboard (dashboardUrl set): run pilot.py event <n> --action approved --phase discovery and push the events (plus the created ones) with ArtifactData, best-effort.
Wiki module on: call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-wiki-entries.md (status proposed) for the story; put any conflicts question to the human and settle it first.

Apply wiki entries on branch wiki/discovery-<story n> via pilot.py wiki add/set, run wiki lint, commit docs(wiki) with the required Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailer, push, open one PR ending with the required Claude Code attribution lines, and give the human the link without merging.
Report the issue number(s)/URL(s) and the wiki PR link to the human.
Read .pilot/pilot-process.md, pilot-link-ticket-tree.md, pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md, pilot-link-roster.md and pilot-link-existing-analysis.md before running.
Determine input: a raw idea ('save a place as favorite') in --human mode; it reads as a product idea, not tech/bug, so continue (no --resume/--from-proto).
Fetch open level:epic issues (title+body) via list_issues/search_issues; result is none.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-analyze-existing.md, the analysis link doc in full, the raw idea and the (empty) Epic list; hold the analysis and show the human its 'Touched by this input' and 'Not covered' parts.

With --human, ask the human once for their proposal (one story or several, Epic, acceptance criteria, decisions already held); then call pilot-pm with pilot-task-frame-idea.md (idea, Epic list, framing conversation) to challenge it and restate the brief, relaying challenges to the human round by round.
Feed the human's replies back to pilot-pm and repeat framing rounds until the brief is ready and the human confirms it (or accepts provisional defaults).

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-write-story.md, the existing-analysis doc, the analysis, the validated brief, the human's proposal and empty Epic list to write up the story (never adding its own decisions).

Call Agent pilot-architect with pilot-task-anticipate-architecture.md, existing-analysis doc, the analysis, the draft only, plus pilot-link-knowledge.md and pilot-link-architecture.md (architecture module on) to validate.

If the architect objects, run the PM/architect dialogue (agent-dialogue turn-taking), putting any human-dependent question to the human before creating tickets, until convergence (single story, possibly with a tech companion; no Epic since none exists unless several stories).

Create the draft ticket(s) via issue_write (type:feature, level:story, status:draft, priority, assigned to session; new Epic first with sub_issue_write links if several stories), then run pilot.py event <n>... --action created --phase discovery.

Show the human the drafted story/stories with real issue numbers and the anticipated architecture; put the PM's open questions to the human; ask once about a mockup (existing, sketch live, or prose) for the user-facing UI feature and tell them to attach it themselves as a comment.

Check ticket comments for attachments, feed corrections/answers back into the dialogue, write each round's changes into the draft with issue_write, and repeat until the human approves (or set wont-do and close if out of scope).
Final consolidation: have the dialogue re-read each draft body as a whole and fix incoherences across rounds.
Finalize: flip each story from status:draft to status:backlog, unassigned via issue_write (no prototype handling since not --from-proto).

Dashboard (dashboardUrl is set): run pilot.py event <n>... --action approved --phase discovery and push the returned events plus the created ones via ArtifactData (ToolSearch to load if deferred), best-effort.

Wiki module on: call pilot-pm with pilot-task-wiki-entries.md (target status proposed, project language from pilot.py module list, knowledge and wiki link docs, finalized story, touched domains) for the story.
Put any returned 'conflicts' questions to the human and settle them before applying.

On branch wiki/discovery-<story n>, apply add/update/remove via pilot.py wiki commands, run wiki lint, commit (docs(wiki): …) with the required Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers, push, open one PR with the pull-request description ending with the required attribution; give the human the link, never merge.
Report the story issue number(s)/URL(s) and the wiki PR link to the human; stop (no splitting, dependencies or spec).

Read .pilot/pilot-process.md, pilot-link-existing-analysis.md, pilot-link-ticket-tree.md, pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md and pilot-link-roster.md; note --human (no --multi, no --resume), raw idea given.
Determine input: raw idea 'Let travelers save a place as a favorite.' It is a product idea, not a tech need or bug, so proceed without analyzing it myself.
Fetch open level:epic issues (title and body) via list_issues/search_issues as candidates for reuse; none exist.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-analyze-existing.md, the analysis link in full, the raw idea and the (empty) Epic list; hold the analysis and show the human its 'Touched by this input' and 'Not covered' parts.
Because of --human, ask the human once for their proposal: one story or several, the Epic, acceptance criteria and decisions they already hold.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-frame-idea.md, the idea, Epic list and the human's proposal; show the PM's challenges and restated brief conversationally, feed the replies back, and repeat rounds until the brief is ready and the human confirms it (or accepts the provisional defaults).

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-write-story.md, the analysis link, the analysis, the validated brief, the idea, the Epic list and the human's proposal to write up the story and challenge it, without adding decisions of its own.

Call Agent pilot-architect with pilot-task-anticipate-architecture.md, the analysis link, pilot-link-knowledge.md and pilot-link-architecture.md in full (architecture module on), the analysis and the draft only, to validate it.

If the architect objects, run the PM/architect/human dialogue per pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md and put any human-dependent question to the human before creating anything. Then re-validate the revised draft until convergence on a single story (or story plus tech enabler), or out of scope.

Create the draft story with issue_write: type:feature, level:story, status:draft, a priority label, assigned to this session. No Epic is needed (a sub_issue link only if the dialogue decided on one). Then run pilot.py event <n> --action created --phase discovery.

Show the human the drafted story with its real issue number and the anticipated architecture. Put the PM's open questions to the human, and ask about a mockup (existing, sketch live, or prose) since this is user-facing UI. Check the ticket comments for an attachment before each round. Write each round's changes into the ticket with issue_write and repeat until the human approves.
Final consolidation: have the dialogue re-read the whole draft body and fix any incoherence across rounds, then update the ticket.
Finalize with issue_write: flip the story from status:draft to status:backlog and unassign it. (The --from-proto parts are skipped.)

Dashboard (dashboardUrl is set): run pilot.py event <n> --action approved --phase discovery. Push these events and the created ones from step 4 with ArtifactData (loaded via ToolSearch if deferred). This is best-effort.

Wiki module on: call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-wiki-entries.md (target status proposed), the project language, knowledge and wiki links, the finalized story and its domains, to get the wiki entries.
If the PM returns any conflicts, put each to the human and settle it before applying.

On branch wiki/discovery-<story n>, apply the add/update/remove entries with pilot.py wiki add/set, run wiki lint, commit with docs(wiki) plus the Co-Authored-By trailer, push, and open one PR via create_pull_request (with the Claude Code footer in its description). Do not merge it.
Report the story issue number and URL and the wiki PR link to the human, who merges the PR.
